subject: small medieval wooden fishing boat
features: a small clinker-built open fishing boat of weathered oak planks, a single short mast with a furled patched brown sail, four oars resting across the thwarts, fishing nets, a wicker basket and a coil of rope in the hull, a steering oar at the stern

subject: medieval cog merchant ship
features: a broad round-bellied medieval cog of overlapping clinker oak planks, a high straight stern with a hanging rudder, a single tall mast with one large square sail of off-white canvas with faded red stripes, a raised wooden castle with crenellated rails at the stern and a smaller one at the bow, rigging and ratlines, cargo barrels on the deck

subject: late medieval carrack
features: a large late medieval carrack of dark weathered oak, three masts with square sails on the fore and main and a lateen sail on the mizzen, a tall multi-deck forecastle overhanging the bow, a high sterncastle, a long bowsprit, painted wooden shields along the rails, rigging and ratlines, a crow's nest on the main mast

subject: medieval northern longship
features: a long narrow clinker-built medieval longship of weathered oak, a row of long oars along each side, one mast with a large square sail of off-white canvas, a high curved prow and stern post with carved heads, a small covered stern cabin, painted wooden shields along the rails
